distance: Native gDist: camera-to-clump-root Euclidean world metres. Bucket selection uses current grass where present, otherwise previous grass. Ambiguous cross-bucket samples are separate.
mask: Raw 4x MSAA geometric labels at native buffer resolution, linearly resampled to screenshot dimensions. At least 25% coverage, dominant bucket >=80%; both-full subset requires >=90% coverage in both frames. Mask bypasses post; normal picture uses native post/MSAA.
metric: Same screen-pixel consecutive decoded RGB luminance difference, absolute >60. Includes ordinary camera motion, occlusion and post effects; no optical-flow compensation or shimmer-only verdict. Luminance uses exact integer coefficients 2126,7152,722 /10000.

fields.flags: uint8 @7: current grass bit0, previous grass bit1, both-full bit2, either endpoint >=180 bit3
